question: Should the Windows setup LKG promote exactly gateway 2026.7.1 despite the unresolved startup report, or wait for a proven fixed release?
rationale: Source review can confirm the constant is changed correctly, but only a release owner can accept or defer the user-facing availability risk after reviewing exact-version runtime evidence.

options.title: Wait for a proven release
options.body: Keep this standing PR in draft and promote a newer or republished version after the startup issue is resolved and the full Windows/WSL acceptance matrix passes.

options.title: Promote after exact-version proof
options.body: Merge 2026.7.1 only if current-head testing proves the reported failure is inapplicable and all fresh, repair, pairing, health, and rollback paths pass.

options.title: Accept the known risk
options.body: Promote 2026.7.1 with an explicit release-owner rationale and documented recovery path for affected installations.

recommendation.title: Wait for a proven release
recommendation.body: Keep this standing PR in draft and promote a newer or republished version after the startup issue is resolved and the full Windows/WSL acceptance matrix passes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate for this setup-version surface and supplied the concrete release-acceptance criteria in the discussion.
